EMERGENCY (ESSENTIAL POWERS)
ORDINANCE No. 38, 1970

An Ordinance promulgated by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong
under Article 150 (2) of th¢ Constitution.

(15th July, 1970.)

WHEREAS by reason of the existence of a grave emergency

P.U. (A)     threatening the security of Malaysia, a Proclamation of

145/69. Emergency has been issued by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong
under Article 150 of the Constitution;

P.U, (A)       AND WHEREAS Parliament was dissolved on the twentieth
id ae       day of March, 1969 and elections to the new Dewan Ra‘ayat
have not been completed;

AND WHEREAS the Yang di-Rertuan Agong is satisfied that
immediate action is required for an Ordinance to be pro-
47/1967.  mulgated to amend the Income Tax Act, 1967;

1009                                     P.U. (A) 256.

IT IS HEREBY ENACTED by the Duli Yang Maha
Mulia Seri Paduka Baginda| Yang di-Pertuan Agong pur-
suant to Clause (2) of Article 150 of the Constitution as
follows:

1. This Ordinance may be cited as the Emergency (Essential
Powers) Ordinance, No. 38, 1970.

2. (1) The Income Tax Act,}1967 shall be read subject to
the amendments specified in the Schedule hereto.

(2) The amendments specified in the Schedule hereto shall
be deemed to have effect or shall have effect on such dates
as may be specified in the said Schedule.
